title: Enforce memory mutation scope predicates
summary: Enforce stable memory mutation scope predicates for purge, repair, and compaction so signed scopes constrain destructive memory operations at dispatch.
expectedFailureModes: A scoped memory repair grant can mutate a different record than the operator intended.
A scoped compaction grant can delete or stale-mark tiers outside the signed scope.
Memory purge can delete records without any capability or cutoff scope enforcement.
nextAction: Implement memory purge capability gating plus dispatch-time scope checks for repair and compaction.
